excerpt.zh: 对[From.GetName]的光学扫描中，在其部分表面发现了类似小屋的建筑结构，证明此处之前可能有生物居住。
excerpt.en: Optical scans of the planet [From.GetName] have revealed small hut-like structures littering parts of its surface, suggesting it is inhabited.

texts.zh: 对[From.GetName]的光学扫描中，在其部分表面发现了类似小屋的建筑结构，证明此处之前可能有生物居住。
texts.en: Optical scans of the planet [From.GetName] have revealed small hut-like structures littering parts of its surface, suggesting it is inhabited.

sections.zh: 对[From.GetName]的光学扫描中，在其部分表面发现了类似小屋的建筑结构，证明此处之前可能有生物居住。
sections.en: Optical scans of the planet [From.GetName] have revealed small hut-like structures littering parts of its surface, suggesting it is inhabited.

texts.zh:
通过进一步观察[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]我们发现，其表面的房屋状结构是一种软体动物的家园。这些房屋都处于十分原始的状态，由土壤混合类似分辨的分泌物建造而成。

这种软体动物具有半智能和有限的智力。除生存之外，其社会与生活主要以发掘矿物为主。发掘出的矿物则会进行展示，提升发掘者的社会地位。

然而，他们探测矿物位置的方式目前尚不明确，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]被他们探知大量矿藏的能力深深震撼。

虽然这些软体动物的科学技术与几乎全部其他方面均比我们落后许多，但却可能对我们的采矿能力造成极大的帮助。
texts.en:
A closer look at [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] has shown that its hut-like structures are home to a molluscoid species. The huts are crude shelters, built out of soil and quasi-fecal excretions.

The molluscoids appear semi-sapient with limited intelligence. Besides survival, their society and lives revolve around unearthing minerals which are then put on display, seemingly to raise the social standing of the finder.

Their means of locating these minerals remain unclear, however, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is baffled by their ability to locate large deposits of minerals.

Though technologically inferior, studying these molluscoids may well further our mining capabilities.

label.zh: 有点意思。对他们再进行更深的研究。

texts.zh: 对此软体类物种进行研究，试着搞明白他们是怎样如此轻松地发现矿脉的。
texts.en: Research the molluscoid species and attempt to discover their means of locating mineral deposits with such ease.

texts.zh:
[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]上居住的软体生物会使用一种奇异的方式来寻找他们想要的矿物。

目前看来，他们可从皮肤排出一种分泌物，渗入土壤并进一步下探。不知为何，这种分泌物具有感应能力，只要连接不断，即可为这种软体动物提供信息。以这种办法，他们就可以对超大规模的地下结构进行测绘，并探明被分泌物触碰到的矿藏。

若能将这些软体动物整合入我们的社会，或单纯使用这种技术来提升我们的生产工序，应该会令我们的矿物生产设施大受裨益。
texts.en:
The molluscoids inhabiting [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] employ a strange method to locate their coveted minerals.

Apparently their skin naturally produces gelatinous secretions which seep into the porous soil, trickling ever downward while remaining attached to their skin as long strings. These secretions effectively sample the soil, feeding back sensory information to the molluscoid individual as long as the slimy strands remain unbroken. In this manner, they are able to map out surprisingly large parts of the underground terrain and map out mineral veins.

If we were to integrate the molluscoids into our society, or simply advance our production processes with this knowledge, it is likely our mining enterprises would benefit greatly.

label.zh: 别管什么矿物了，收获它们的基因。
label.en: Never mind the minerals, harvest the DNA.

label.zh: 好。我们就对这些知识加以利用吧。
label.en: Yes, we will use this knowledge.

label.zh: 不。对他们的星球进行开采。

texts.zh: 立刻着手将这些软体类矿工整合入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会。
texts.en: Commence the integration of the molluscoid miners into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society.

texts.zh:
软体类物种已成功整合入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会。

为了促进整合进程，我们将他们命名为[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]。[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]性情温顺，工作勤奋，目前已观察到我们对矿物产量有了显著提升。
texts.en:
The integration of the molluscoids into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is complete.

To facilitate the integration, they have been given the name [molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]. The [molluscoid_miners_species.GetName] are obedient and hardworking, and a marked increase in our mineral production has already been observed.

texts.zh: 开始研究并应用可以高速勘探地下地形并制图的系统，以求提升矿物生产效率。
texts.en: Begin research and implementation of a system able to swiftly chart underground terrain, with the end goal of improving mineral production.

texts.zh:
一套能够快速勘测地下地形并探明其包含的矿藏的系统现已投入使用。

通过利用无法穿透矿物质的特定恒星射线与宇宙射线，我们可以收集关于天体内部矿藏数量的数据。这如同为天体直接拍一张X光片，无论是小行星或行星的一部分都可以实现精准探测。

我们对科学家称其为矿物测绘，这一技术应当可以大大提高我们的采矿效率。
texts.en:
A system enabling us to quickly chart underground terrain and the minerals it contains has been implemented.

By analyzing planetary reflection of particular solar and cosmic rays, which are unable to penetrate most minerals, we can gather data on the crust's mineral composition. This makes it possible to essentially x-ray a target body, be it an asteroid or part of a planet.

Our scientists have dubbed it Mineral Mapping, and it should greatly improve our mineral production.
